moves.label: Quick Sunlight Jab
moves.description: Fast high spear jab with a tiny active window for checking close pressure.
moves.reason: Compact standing thrust with Sunlight Heart held high.

moves.label: Low Sunlight Sweep
moves.description: Fast low spear sweep with long active coverage along the ground.
moves.reason: Crouched low spear arc travels across shin height.

moves.label: Sunlight Body Thrust
moves.description: Quick mid spear thrust with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Mid-height forward lance stab.

moves.label: Sunlight Arc Kick
moves.description: Fast mid kick-and-spear arc with a long active window for close scrambles.
moves.reason: Repeated mid-height spinning kick and red spear arc frames.

moves.label: Sunlight Tornado Vault
moves.description: Slow mid aerial tornado slash that jumps in before resetting juggle control.
moves.reason: Vaulting spin has jump and tornado data.

moves.label: Cross Spear Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that drives Sunlight Heart forward with a long active lift.
moves.reason: Low-to-forward spear rush is already authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Grounded Lance Cut
moves.description: Steady mid lance cut with a brief active window and grounded recovery.
moves.reason: Long horizontal spear cut stays around body height.

moves.label: Alchemy Low Feint
moves.description: Fast low feint with long active time from a crouched alchemy-tinted slash.
moves.reason: Orange effect frames stay low and forward.

moves.label: Driving Spear Sweep
moves.description: Quick low knockdown sweep that slides through with extended active frames.
moves.reason: Low driving sweep finishes in a knockdown tumble.

moves.label: Sunlight Power Crush
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown drive with very long active pressure from the spear rush.
moves.reason: Heavy forward rush is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Lance Arc
moves.description: Fast mid crouch attack with long active spear coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch sequence swings the spear through mid space.

moves.label: Full-Crouch Spear Lift
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a short active pop-up after a crouched start.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-rising spear cut is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Sunlight Jab
moves.description: Quick high overdrive jab with a short active window and fast reset.
moves.reason: Overdrive version mirrors the compact high jab.

moves.label: Alchemy Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown rush with long active red-aura spear pressure.
moves.reason: Aura-heavy rush has special level and knockdown data.

moves.label: While-Rising Spear Cut
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising cut with moderate active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Rises into the same mid spear-cut family.

moves.label: Sunlight Rising Sweep
moves.description: Fast mid rising sweep with long active spear coverage out of crouch.
moves.reason: While-standing motion rises into a broad spear arc.

moves.label: Crouch Step Jab
moves.description: Quick high jab with a short active window from a compact crouch-step poke.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the high quick spear poke animation.

moves.label: Diagonal Spear Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a small active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal command uses the rising launcher spear cut.

moves.label: Sunlight Step Flurry
moves.description: Fast mid advancing flurry with long active spear coverage.
moves.reason: Forward command steps through multiple spear-arc frames.

moves.label: Forward Spear Cut
moves.description: Steady mid forward cut with moderate active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses a mid spear-cut sequence.

moves.label: Sunlight Rush Jab
moves.description: Quick high rush jab with a short active window for fast approach checks.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab keeps the compact high spear poke.

moves.label: Sunlight Burst Ender
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown burst with long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Red burst sequence is already authored as a knockdown finisher.
